definitions.explanation: A door or opening designated for escaping a building during a fire, earthquake, or other emergency. Standard wording on safety signage and in fire-code documents.

examples.japanese: {避難口|ひなんぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check where the emergency exits are.

examples.japanese: {避難口|ひなんぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}かないで→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not place objects in front of the emergency exit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充満|じゅうまん}→充満：17055_juuman⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧{避難口|ひなんぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Before the smoke filled the room, we got outside through the nearest emergency exit.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ (evacuation, taking refuge) plus 〜{口|ぐち} (opening, gateway), which voices to ぐち in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避難口|ひなんぐち}⟦{誘導灯|ゆうどうとう}→誘導灯：23857_yuudoutou⟧: emergency exit guidance light
- {避難口|ひなんぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧: to block an emergency exit
- ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{避難口|ひなんぐち}: the nearest emergency exit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧: emergency exit — far more common in everyday speech and on green exit signs; {避難口|ひなんぐち} is the more technical, fire-code term
